entities.name: Aneta Tejralová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aneta Tejralová is a Czech professional ice hockey player for the Seattle Torrent of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL) and captain of the Czech Republic women's national ice hockey team. She previously played for the Ottawa Charge of the PWHL, the Boston Pride of the Premier Hockey Federation (PHF), MODO Hockey of the SDHL, and spent eight seasons in Russia's Zhenskaya Hockey League (ZhHL) with Dynamo St. Petersburg and SKIF Nizhny Novgorod.
